This nerve flossing exercise can help fix a pinched nerve and relieve neck and shoulder pain fast. Join the 30-Day Mobility Challenge here →
If you're dealing with sharp, radiating, or nagging pain in your neck or shoulder, it may be coming from a nerve that isn't gliding the way it should. Nerve flossing (also called nerve gliding) is a gentle technique that helps a compressed or irritated nerve move freely again, easing pain, tingling, and tightness in the neck, shoulder, and down into the arm.
